entries.en:
Despite finding the concept of drinking alcohol to be extremely unappealing, the Vath keeneye turns out to be a dab hand at making wines, and his home-brew causes quite a stir over at the Convictory. Overwhelmed by the amount he has been asked to produce, he turns to you for assistance. Make your way to the Chocobo Forest and gather three ripe caelumtree fruits.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

Guetteur souhaiterait que vous vous rendiez dans la forêt des chocobos afin d'en rapporter trois qu'il distillera. Il pourra ainsi produire une bouteille d'un alcool dont raffolent les chevaliers du Convictoire et qui suffira à les satisfaire temporairement, puisqu'il ne lui en reste pas une en stock. Allez de ce pas à la forêt des chocobos pour lui rapporter ce dont il a tant besoin.

entries.en: You deliver the ripe caelumtree fruits to the Vath keeneye who sets to work, just as a knight from the Convictory appears at the Vath sanctuary. The Convictor is in a desperate hurry to get his wine, but unfortunately for him, it is far from ready. The clever Vath somehow foresaw this would happen, and produces a bottle from his reserve. He asks that you hand it to the restless knight, in hopes that it will tide him over until the new batch of wine is ready.

Comme son client s'est déplacé jusqu'au hameau des Égarés, il n'aura pas le temps de la laisser fermenter cor<->rec<->te<->ment, mais tant pis<nbsp>! Allez remettre <frnoun(EventItem,2,2001960,1,1)> au chevalier du Convictoire.

entries.en: You hand the bottle of caelumtree wine to the impatient Convictor knight, and his anxious twitching seems to subside. He is eager to know what gives the wine its full flavor, but before you can disclose any details, he comes to the conclusion that only the best of ingredients could make such a fine drink. He leaves the Vath sanctuary with a spring in his step and blissfully unaware of the rather dubious additives which have been sprinkled into his wine.

entries.en: How strange, you fleshlings. We talk with you, we trade with you, yet we do not understand. Why do you love this thing called “wine” so much? It dulls the senses. We do not like this.
entries.fr: J'ai cru remarquer que les humains avaient une passion étrange pour les fruits très mûrs... presque moisis, ksss ksss. Ils les font fermenter et boivent jusqu'à l'ivresse ce liquide qu'ils appellent alcool, sans se soucier des effets incapacitants de cette boisson.
entries.ja:
シシシシシ……つくづく、ヒトとは不可解なものだ。
なんでも、「酒」という発酵させた果汁を飲んで、
わざと能力を鈍らせることを楽しむそうじゃないか？

entries.en: All done! Now, we must let it ferment. This will take time. Our restless friend over there, however, cannot wait so long. He says he is here to collect the wine we were to deliver to the Convictory. It is a good thing we anticipated his arrival! Please take this bottle to him.
entries.fr: Voilà<nbsp>! Normalement, il faudrait laisser le mélange reposer un peu, mais l'humain impatient du Convictoire est venu chercher sa <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001960,1,1)> jusqu'ici. Il n'aura qu'à la laisser fermenter lui-même. Vous voulez bien la lui remettre, ksss<nbsp>?

だが、気の短いヒトの騎兵が、ここまで取りにきている。
この寝かせておいた「」を渡してくれ。

entries.en: Ah, there it is─the wine of all wines. There isn't another drink like it! The flavors─the sweetness, the acidity, and the hint of some sort of exotic spice, perhaps─they play across the length of your tongue and trail into the pit of your stomach, leaving you warm and content.
entries.fr: Mince alors, j'ai bien cru que jamais je ne pourrais en boire à nouveau<nbsp>! Ce parfum, et cette petite pointe d'acidité... c'est l'extase<nbsp>! Et en plus d'être grisant, ça tient vraiment chaud. C'est pas du luxe quand on connaît un peu le climat du Convictoire<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
どうも、ありがとう！
独特な香りと酸味があって、美味いんだな～これが。
気持ちよく酔える上に、身体もポカポカ温まるんだよ～。

entries.en: I wonder what exactly it could be that lends the wine such a unique flavor. Whenever I ask, the Vath always seem hesitant to tell me. \<sigh> I suppose it's a silly question, anyway. It's glaringly obvious something this good can only be crafted with the finest of ingredients!

entries.fr: Je me demande bien quels fruits ils utilisent et quel procédé de fabrication ils suivent... Bah, l'important c'est que ce soit bon<nbsp>! Je vais me régaler ce soir, j'en laisserai pas une goutte.
